analysis.decision_rule: BETTER iff primary lo > 0, primary exact McNemar p < 0.05 and safety hi <= margin; WORSE iff (primary hi < 0 and its McNemar p < 0.05) or (safety lo > 0 and its McNemar p < 0.05); SAFETY_FAIL iff primary lo > 0 with p < 0.05 but safety hi > margin; else INCONCLUSIVE; INVALID when the study-level deficiency limits are exceeded
